title: Degen's `native-record` job re-runs by itself when the Mac `native-check` status posts to the PR head, so no one reruns it by hand
why:
Coordinator 01:51 CST Nov 14 (relayed; the consultant relays the Degen coordinator's feedback, owner paste 01:42 CST, "10 PRs sat red on it"; unread by triage): in degen's .github/workflows/checks.yml the `native-record` job (scripts/native_run_check.py reads the live `native-check` status) goes red when the Mac status posts after the job ran, and someone reruns it by hand. DONE 17:59 CST Nov 14: degen #711 (lane degen-native-record-reread) MERGED by runner 11 at about 17:57 CST Nov 14, degen main d7ef42fc2ab9, head f57f8a785edc (coordinator 17:57, ls-remote 17:57, relayed from runner 11's report; triage read none). Lane lint PASS at 17:31 CST; all-jobs-passed read by name, success 17:47 CST. The tool printed "prose judge UNKNOWN: 2 lines not judged" (not a block; unknown, not clear). Degen main push run 993 in progress; runner 11 reads it next. Matched by the lane name only: the coordinator wrote the step as native-record-reread; this step is degen-native-record-reread. The step text asks the lane to count the red cases first (the 10 PRs); whether it did is unread. Set done on the strength of the lane name and the merge; moves back to doing if the PR did not build this step.

GitHub REST read 00:08 CST Nov 15 (Degen feedback status pass, triage fork; no diff read): the status reads done, but the note still says the lane is not started. Degen's repo is outside this session's GitHub scope, so nothing was verified.
source: Likely route, unverified (the coordinator's): a workflow on the `status` event for context native-check that re-runs native-record for that sha. A lane should check, before building, what GitHub runs for a `status` event (the workflow file on the default branch, not the PR's), and whether the rerun can use the repo's own token. Neighbours: native-check-status-hand-post (todo: a hook refuses a hand-posted native-check status), own-770-a-degen-702-mac-rerun (ruling: the Mac leg of degen #702 re-run once; the Mac was offline then). Tracker runner 11, path ALONE.
note: Triage 01:54 CST Nov 14: first the lane counts the red cases (the 10 PRs: numbers and sha, from degen's run history, with the sample size) and proves the cause is a status that posts after the job ran, not a Mac that never posts. Red first: a PR whose `native-check` status posts after `native-record` ran goes green with no manual rerun; control: a PR whose status never posts stays red (the job does not pass without the Mac). A change to degen's CI, not a guard; own small PR, draft (grant Lane draft PR). The coordinator starts the lane when this reads ready.
